figure.note: A rare case where the American form has an extra /j/ glide that the British form lacks.

senses.definition: A number, especially one that forms part of official statistics.
examples: The latest unemployment figures were published today.
Sales reached six figures for the first time.

senses.definition: The shape of a person's body, or a person seen at a distance.
examples: A tall figure appeared at the end of the corridor.
He is a well-known figure in local politics.
